Sets the [audio latency](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/AudioContext/AudioContext) hint for the global `AudioContext` context that Remotion uses to play audio.<br />Possible values: `interactive`, `balanced`, `playback`

## CLI flag

Use `--audio-latency-hint` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                           | Flag                           |
| ------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)             | `--audio-latency-hint <value>` |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)             | `--audio-latency-hint <value>` |
| [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)               | `--audio-latency-hint <value>` |
| [`remotion compositions`](/docs/cli/compositions) | `--audio-latency-hint <value>` |
| [`remotion bundle`](/docs/cli/bundle)             | `--audio-latency-hint <value>` |
